value.rationale: The rhombicuboctahedron is a canonical Archimedean metric configuration singled out by the literature as a natural next class beyond Platonic solids. A sharp, exact integral Rips homotopy filtration exhibits 17 one-circles, an inclusion-persistent two-sphere at a strictly earlier Euclidean threshold than the graph-power calculation, and a nontrivial seven-three-sphere transition at graph distance three. These are specific natural persistence and homotopy invariants not implied by the known graph-scale-two result, not arbitrary parameter slices or mere Betti-number reproduction.
